scripts.postbuild: npm run build:schemas && npm run i18n:build && cp metadata.json dist/ && cp LICENSE.md dist/ && mkdir -p dist/schemas && cp schemas/*.gschema.xml schemas/gschemas.compiled dist/schemas/ && mkdir -p dist/assets && cp assets/*.svg dist/assets/
scripts.i18n:pot: mkdir -p po && xgettext --from-code=UTF-8 --language=JavaScript --keyword=_ --add-comments=Translators --copyright-holder='Hervé Brun' --msgid-bugs-address='https://github.com/herve-brun/find-my-mouse-example.com/issues' --package-name='Find My Mouse' --package-version="$(node -p "require('./metadata.json')['version-name']")" --output=po/find-my-mouse@herve-brun.github.io.pot dist/*.js && sed -i -e '1s/.*/# Find My Mouse translation template./' -e '0,/^#, fuzzy$/s/^#, fuzzy$//' po/find-my-mouse@herve-brun.github.io.pot
scripts.i18n:build: for lang in en fr es; do mkdir -p "dist/locale/$lang/LC_MESSAGES" && msgfmt --check --check-format --output-file="dist/locale/$lang/LC_MESSAGES/find-my-mouse@herve-brun.github.io.mo" "po/$lang.po" || exit 1; done
scripts.i18n:update: npm run i18n:pot && for lang in en fr es; do msgmerge --update --backup=none "po/$lang.po" po/find-my-mouse@herve-brun.github.io.pot || exit 1; done
scripts.build:dist: npm run build && cd dist && zip -qr ../find-my-mouse@herve-brun.github.io.zip .
